assessment.nobel_worthiness: Induced proximity and hijacking of the ubiquitin-proteasome system to degrade chosen proteins is a new pharmacological paradigm; PROTACs and the cereblon mechanism of thalidomide-type molecular glues are mechanistically clear and chemically original, and degraders are now in clinical trials.
assessment.attribution: Crews conceived and developed PROTACs and Deshaies helped establish the early concept and E3 biology; Handa identified cereblon as the thalidomide target. Ciulli, Ito, Gray and others made major contributions, so a three-person cut is contestable.
assessment.maturity: Strong independent validation across many labs and a mature clinical pipeline; timing is good, although clinical benefit is still accumulating.
uncertainties: The prize may split between PROTAC and molecular-glue lineages with unresolved credit among Crews, Deshaies, Handa, Ciulli and Gray.
I recall the details from memory and have not verified them independently.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Base editors chemically convert one base into another in genomic DNA without double-strand breaks, an elegant use of deaminase chemistry on DNA that enables precise correction of point mutations. Its impact on research and therapy is large.
assessment.attribution: David R. Liu led the invention; Komor (C-to-T) and Gaudelli (A-to-G, via evolved TadA on DNA) were the decisive first authors. Nishida and Kondo made a parallel independent deaminase-based approach.
assessment.maturity: Confirmed across many labs, and early clinical use is under way; recognition would be timely, though the field is young and still moving.
uncertainties: Whether the prize would go to Liu alone, or to Liu with prime editing, or be split with the Nishida/Kondo work.
Possible overlap with CRISPR-based prizes already awarded in 2020.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Liquid-liquid phase separation as a principle organizing cellular biochemistry (P granules, nucleoli, signaling condensates) is conceptually transformative for cell and physical biochemistry and has changed how we think about compartmentalization of nucleic acids and proteins.
assessment.attribution: Brangwynne and Hyman established the liquid-like behavior of P granules in 2009; Rosen showed multivalent phase separation in signaling assemblies. Pappu and Mittag contributed physical and sequence-grammar frameworks.
assessment.maturity: Widely reproduced and highly influential, but debate continues about physiological relevance, the definition of condensates, and in vitro versus in vivo behaviour.
uncertainties: Physiological significance of many reported condensates is still contested.
The work may be judged biology or physics rather than chemistry.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Massively parallel sequencing-by-synthesis with reversible terminators made genomes, transcriptomes and DNA damage mapping routine. The chemistry of reversible terminators and clonal cluster arrays is original, with huge impact on my own field of DNA replication and mutation.
assessment.attribution: Balasubramanian and Klenerman founded Solexa chemistry; Mayer contributed the colony and cluster amplification concept. Rothberg (pyrosequencing and Ion Torrent) and Ju (terminators) are other credible claims.
assessment.maturity: Fully mature and globally validated; the question is timing, as the discovery dates from the late 1990s and early 2000s.
uncertainties: Competing platform lineages (454, Ion Torrent, Ju) complicate fair attribution.
Sequencing already received a Chemistry prize in 1980, which may count against it.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Ionizable lipid nanoparticles made RNA medicines deliverable, as shown by the mRNA vaccines and siRNA therapeutics; the lipid chemistry design (pKa tuning, PEG-lipids, microfluidic formulation) is central.
assessment.attribution: Cullis and colleagues built the ionizable lipid and LNP formulation technology; Anderson and Langer contributed combinatorial lipid-like materials. Credit between Cullis, MacLachlan, Madden, Hope and others is intricate.
assessment.maturity: Validated at global scale by COVID-19 vaccines, though the 2023 Medicine prize went to the mRNA side and not the delivery side, so timing is plausible but uncertain.
uncertainties: Attribution is complicated by patents and many contributors.
Committee may view it as covered by the 2023 Medicine prize.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Phosphoramidite chemistry made automated, reliable oligonucleotide synthesis possible and underpins PCR primers, sequencing, gene synthesis, aptamers and nucleic acid therapeutics, so it is fundamental to my field.
assessment.attribution: Caruthers developed the phosphoramidite method, building on earlier phosphotriester work. Hood is credited for automation, but a single laureate seems cleanest.
assessment.maturity: Very mature, with decades of use; the discovery is old (early 1980s), and the late recognition may be viewed as either overdue or stale.
uncertainties: Hood's role and earlier work by Letsinger and Khorana complicate credit.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Genetic code expansion with orthogonal tRNA/synthetase pairs allows site-specific incorporation of noncanonical amino acids in living cells; it is a creative combination of chemistry and biology with wide usage.
assessment.attribution: Schultz established the first orthogonal pairs in E. coli and yeast and Wang was a co-originator; Chin extended them to multicellular organisms and to quadruplet and multi-site recoding.
assessment.maturity: Mature and widely used, but therapeutic and industrial application is still limited.
uncertainties: Split of credit among Schultz, Chin, Wang, Mehl and Yokoyama is unclear.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Reversible mRNA methylation (m6A, FTO, METTL3, readers) established an epitranscriptomic regulatory layer and drove development of chemical tools for RNA modification mapping. It is highly influential.
assessment.attribution: Chuan He proposed the reversible RNA methylation concept and identified FTO as an eraser; Jaffrey and Rechavi with Dominissini mapped m6A transcriptome-wide in 2012. The set of contributors is large and disputed.
assessment.maturity: Rapidly maturing; physiological roles are well supported, but quantification, antibody artefacts and site-level mapping remain debated.
uncertainties: Mapping artefacts and context dependence persist.
The work may be considered more Medicine than Chemistry.
